title: A contractible factor preserves universal localization
statement: Use small simplicial sets, degreewise products and weak contractibility of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and universal localization of [def-coef-universally-localizing-simplicial-map]. Let $f:A\to B$ be universally localizing and let $C$ be a small weakly contractible simplicial set, meaning that $C\to\Delta^0$ is a weak homotopy equivalence. Then $A\times C\xrightarrow{\operatorname{pr}_A}A\xrightarrow f B$ is universally localizing. No Kan, quasicategory or finiteness hypothesis is imposed on $A,B,C$.
